about.en: Macquarie University, established in 1964, is one of Australia's premier recognized universities, holding a prominent global position (Rank 133 QS World University Rankings 2025). The university delivers world-class academic education and cutting-edge research in close collaboration with leading global industries, offering international students a dynamic multicultural campus and exceptional graduate career prospects.
